title: Shortest vectors in Hermitian lattices
exact_target: Find the optimal guaranteed short-vector bound in integral positive-definite Hermitian lattices with fixed rank and determinant over an imaginary quadratic PID.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 8800051 (AMR-087-0051). CC BY 4.0.
